ruleDefinitions.name: WMIC Unquoted Services Path Lookup - PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects known WMI recon method to look for unquoted service paths, often used by pentest inside of powershell scripts attackers enum scripts Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-WmiObject\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*gwmi\\ .*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ Win32\\_Service\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Name.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*DisplayName.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*PathName.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*StartMode.*")))
